name: uams-web/uamswp-acfcdt-migrator
description: Moves ACF values out of ACF Custom Database Tables into core postmeta with snapshot, verify and rollback.

scripts-descriptions.pint: Format the PHP files with Pint.
scripts-descriptions.refactor:sweep: Apply Rector's sweep profile (run deliberately, review the diff).
scripts-descriptions.lint:floor: Parse every shipped PHP file with the PHP that runs the script; run it under PHP 8.2.
scripts-descriptions.stan: Run PHPStan at the configured level.
scripts-descriptions.setup:integration: Install the Integration suite's own Composer setup (PHPUnit 9.6, wp-phpunit, the polyfills).
scripts-descriptions.test: Run both suites, each in its own process, so the Unit suite never sees WordPress.
scripts-descriptions.test:pint: Check formatting with Pint without changing files.
scripts-descriptions.test:integration: Run the PHPUnit 9.6 suite that boots WordPress and the real ACF plugin stack against the test database.
scripts-descriptions.test:unit: Run the Pest suite that needs no WordPress and no database.
scripts-descriptions.mutate: Run the mutation pass over includes, covered code only.
